transcript: What is the oldest tree in the world? Many people think of a great oak But there is an ancient tree Far older than any oak High in the mountains of California A bristlecone pine has survived For over 4,000 years It is one of the oldest living trees on earth The bristlecone pine grows slowly Compared with other pines, it may add only a few millimeters each year But it is far stronger In the high mountains, the air is thin, the wind is cold And the soil is poor Yet such a harsh environment is what has enabled the long life of this tree Scientists measure the age of these trees from growth rings within the wood One has been found to be more than 4,800 years old We cannot help admiring a tree that is older than many civilizations It is among the most remarkable living beings Carrying silence and strength together

segments.text: What is the oldest tree in the world?
Many people think of a great oak
But there is an ancient tree
High in the mountains of California
It is one of the oldest living trees on earth
Compared with other pines, it may add only a few millimeters each year
In the high mountains, the air is thin, the wind is cold
Yet such a harsh environment is what has enabled the long life of this tree
Scientists measure the age of these trees from growth rings within the wood
One has been found to be more than 4,800 years old
We cannot help admiring a tree that is older than many civilizations
It is among the most remarkable living beings
